title: Keep two-page content priority and retire one-page subset optimization
summary: The user amendment replaces one-page-only fitting: one, one-and-a-half or two pages are acceptable, with readable fonts/spacing and no stranded employer headings.
body: The user amendment replaces one-page-only fitting: one, one-and-a-half or two pages are acceptable, with readable fonts/spacing and no stranded employer headings. Keep useful content and at most four bullets per employer. If three pages occur inspect formatting, duplication and verbose wording first; preserve and report a still-oversized draft instead of silently deleting accomplishments. Source 011 final-visible coverage and document-specific repair rules remain active, while its elaborate one-page subset search is retired.
